title: ImmoVia Hausverwaltung
description: immovia-hausverwaltung.de ImmoVia Hausverwaltung GmbH is a German property management company registered in November 2025 in Bautzen, Saxony, founded by property owners who bring their own landlord experience to managing rental properties and condominium associations. Led by Managing Director Ramona Biehle with equal shareholders holding 33.3 percent each, the firm offers rental management, WEG administration, technical building management and DATEV-compatible tax data integration. Its philosophy is reliable, solution-oriented and personal management treating each property as if it were its own.
